The article supplies2/0/0reporteddeaths, treated142/141/140,and exhaustively attributes the two1.5mgdeaths to uterinecarcinoma andpneumonia. ProtocolGBGE(b) makesweek24/Visit11orET the finalplannedvisit; it provides no routine additional post-treatment visit. Its after-discharge rule is passive reporting of relatedSAEs learned later,not a mandated additional planned observation period. Incomplete examination of other related sources does not invalidate this sufficient compatible positive proof.

This is an admissible derivation within the AE modality, not a directly reported suicide-specific count or transport of registry all-cause mortality.
